condition_descriptions.h_in_patch: Replace pre-layer residual at last token → layer recomputes
condition_descriptions.attn_out_patch: Replace attention output at last token → MLP computes from mixed context
condition_descriptions.h_after_attn_patch: Replace post-attn residual at last token → LayerNorm+MLP recompute
condition_descriptions.mlp_input_recompute: Replace MLP input (post-LayerNorm) at last token → MLP recomputes
condition_descriptions.mlp_out_patch: Replace MLP output at last token (= full_mlp)
condition_descriptions.full_resid_patch: Replace entire layer output at last token (= full_resid)
